# Pulsus Talent

> Performance appraisal software for the whole organisation: goals, reviews, calibration, the 9-box, anonymous 360 feedback, development plans and succession.

This is the official website of Pulsus Talent: https://abouttalent.pulsus.tech/
Pulsus Talent is part of the Pulsus Intelligence Suite (https://about.pulsus.tech/), made by Tumblehill Labs, a product studio of Tumblehill Holdings LLC. It works on its own.

## What it is

Pulsus Talent is performance appraisal and 360 feedback software. It runs performance appraisals for a whole organisation: Balanced Scorecard objectives and behaviours rated 1 to 5, goals, calibration and the 9-box, 360 feedback, development plans and succession, with reports for each person and for the group.

## Key features

- Pulse: The team score, at a glance
- Team: Every review, and where it has got to
- Goals: Measured, weighted, linked
- Calibration: Fair ratings, reasons on file
- 9-box: Performance across, potential up
- 360 feedback: Honest views, nobody exposed
- Succession: Cover for the roles you can't leave empty
- Reports: PDF, Excel and an organisation chart

## Price

- $11 per employee a month, with every feature included. For more than 50 people, talk to us about Enterprise.
- Prices in US dollars, as shown on the plans page: https://abouttalent.pulsus.tech/plans/
- 14-day free trial, no card needed.
